verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for an MCP connection and registry platform, but nothing in the evidence shows Smithery offering cron, scheduled, or recurring execution. The documented Triggers feature is event-driven: it proxies upstream event subscriptions. That is an adjacent capability, not a recurring schedule, so it earns no credit. The hosted services were also shut down on 2026-10-31.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
